history.question: what is an AI agent
history.answer:
[Ch. 1] "An LLM agent is a large language model embedded in a loop of reasoning, acting, and feedback, where it can call external tools and adapt its behavior based on results."
An AI agent is a system that uses a language model to think, act, and learn from its actions.
